column1: # Copy to <your-repo>/.anon/names.tsv (GITIGNORED). One rule per line:
#   CATEGORY<TAB>real            (a literal TAB between the two)
# CASE-SENSITIVE and matched whole-word where the edge is a word char. Declare
# each case variant you need separately. Longer reals are applied first, so list
# both "Acme" and "Acme Trading Ltd" — the long one wins.
# The engine mints a stable placeholder (ANON_<CATEGORY>_NNN) per distinct real and
# persists it in .anon/map.tsv, so the mapping is reversible and consistent across
# files/runs. GUIDs and Windows/WSL user paths are auto-detected — no need to list.
